entities.name: Query Ccr4 protein
observations: 768 aa protein; predicted molecular mass 86.6 kDa and theoretical pI 7.06.
N-terminal half contains extensive glutamine/asparagine/proline-rich low-complexity sequence, consistent with intrinsic disorder and potential regulatory interactions.
Pfam detects LRR-related sequence around residues 392-448 and an Exo_endo_phos domain at residues 541-760.
Sequence is 100% identical over the query to reviewed Candida glabrata Ccr4 (Q6FRT2) in the returned homology search.
Likely catalytic CCR4-NOT complex subunit with 3'-5' exoribonuclease/deadenylase activity; exact substrate specificity is inferred from homologs rather than directly tested for this sequence.
Homolog annotations place Ccr4 in nucleus and cytoplasm, including P-bodies, as part of the CCR4-NOT complex.

entities.name: Ccr4 homolog
observations: Reviewed fungal Ccr4 homologs are annotated as catalytic components of the CCR4-NOT complex and poly(A)-specific 3'-5' ribonucleases involved in mRNA deadenylation.
Saccharomyces cerevisiae Ccr4 (P31384) is annotated in nucleus, cytoplasm, P-bodies, and CCR4-NOT core complex.

entities.name: CCR4-NOT complex
observations: Ccr4 is a catalytic subunit of the CCR4-NOT core complex, a major mRNA deadenylation and turnover machinery with additional transcriptional roles.
